New joiner：Calculate based on protection policy/last month achievement

Join more than one quarter：

2.

Performance Bonus Rules

2.1 DRM&ARM

•

Quarterly assessment, monthly payment. The performance bonus for the current quarter will be evenly distributed on a monthly basis in the following quarter;

•

Quarterly Performance Bonus = Individual Quarterly Target Performance Bonus Base x Individual Performance Bonus Coefficient for the Current Quarter

<table><colgroup><col width="405"> <col width="381"></colgroup><tbody><tr><td rowspan="1" colspan="1"><p></p><p>Individual performance achievement score (Z)</p><p></p></td><td rowspan="1" colspan="1"><p></p><p>Individual Performance Bonus Coefficient</p><p></p></td></tr><tr><td rowspan="1" colspan="1"><p></p><p>Z ≥ 120</p><p></p></td><td rowspan="1" colspan="1"><p></p><p>1.3</p><p></p></td></tr><tr><td rowspan="1" colspan="1"><p></p><p>90 ≤ Z < 120</p><p></p></td><td rowspan="1" colspan="1"><p></p><p>Z/100</p><p></p></td></tr><tr><td rowspan="1" colspan="1"><p></p><p>80 ≤ Z < 90</p><p></p></td><td rowspan="1" colspan="1"><p></p><p>0.8</p><p></p></td></tr><tr><td rowspan="1" colspan="1"><p></p><p>Z < 80</p><p></p></td><td rowspan="1" colspan="1"><p></p><p>0</p><p></p></td></tr></tbody></table>

2.2 Xiaomi Store manager/Authorized Store Lead consultant

•

Monthly Performance Bonus = Individual Monthly Target Performance Bonus Base x Store Performance Bonus Coefficient for the Current Month x Individual Performance Bonus Coefficient for the Current Month
